boundary: This structural identification does not by itself determine the number of singleton weight-six syndrome fibers. It supplies a smaller geometric carrier for future orbit/Fourier calculations.
theorem: The 240 frozen 45-bit syndrome columns are the point-triangle incidence vectors of a regular 3-uniform linear hypergraph on the 45 intrinsic octets. Every octet lies on 16 triangles, every co-occurring octet pair lies on one triangle, and the 240 triangles partition all 720 edges of SRG(45,32,22,24). Consequently H H^T=16I+A45 with spectrum 48^1,18^24,12^20 and binary rank 45. The U6 syndrome map and the nonlinear cover-signature carrier are therefore two faces of the same 45-octet graph.
